The '''Mikaster sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Armath]], [[Atrakus]], [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]], and [[Mikaster III]].
